description: Scrape Flipkart products by keyword, category URL, product URL or product ID. Add full product details, variants, offers, seller, specifications and reviews.

brand.description: Only products from this brand, e.g. Samsung. Use the exact brand name shown on Flipkart.
brand.title: Brand

categoryUrl.description: Full Flipkart category or browse URL, e.g. https://www.flipkart.com/laptops/pr?sid=6bo%2Cb5g (mode=byCategory)
categoryUrl.title: Category URL

certifiedBuyersOnly.description: Only reviews marked as certified buyer.
certifiedBuyersOnly.title: Certified Buyers Only

includeDetails.description: Open each product page for specifications, variants, offers, seller, images and warranty. Product URLs and IDs always return full details.
includeDetails.title: Include Full Product Details

includeReviews.description: Add buyer review records for each product.
includeReviews.title: Include Reviews

maxItems.description: Maximum number of products to scrape (1-500).
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPages.description: Maximum search/category result pages to read (1-30).
maxPages.title: Max Pages

maxPrice.description: Maximum price filter in Indian Rupees.
maxPrice.title: Maximum Price (INR)

maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Maximum reviews to collect per product when reviews are enabled.
maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max Reviews per Product

minDiscount.description: Only products with at least this discount percentage.
minDiscount.title: Minimum Discount

minPrice.description: Minimum price filter in Indian Rupees.
minPrice.title: Minimum Price (INR)

mode.description: How to find products on Flipkart.
enumTitles: Fetch specific product URLs or IDs
mode.title: Mode

productIds.description: Flipkart product IDs (the pid from a URL) or product URLs. (mode=byUrl)
productIds.title: Product IDs

title: Flipkart Scraper Input
